recognize_zh: 周邊血液三顆漿細胞：核偏位、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質豐富深藍、核旁有淡染區（hof），其中下方細胞可見小核仁；在周邊血抹片看到這樣的漿細胞，應考慮漿細胞白血病。
features: Three circulating plasma cells of medium size
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin; small nucleolus in the lower cell
Background red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant deep-blue cytoplasm with prominent perinuclear hofs; one cell shows a small nucleolus. Red cells and platelets in the background are unremarkable in this thin area. The presence of circulating clonal plasma cells is consistent with plasma cell leukemia in the appropriate clinical context (5% or more circulating plasma cells), and confirmation of light-chain restriction by flow cytometry and cytogenetic risk assessment is advised.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are sparse, occur with other reactive lymphoid forms and show polytypic kappa and lambda expression.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes have a more central nucleus, less abundant cytoplasm and lack a well-defined Golgi hof.

ddx.dx: Leukemic marginal zone or lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show predominantly small lymphocytes with a CD19+/CD20+ clonal B-cell population rather than CD138+/CD19- plasma cells.
